nom: Dermalogica Phyto Nature Lifting Eye Cream

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or hooded, dry under-eyes report the cream feels rich and hydrating, with some noting it resolved dryness and dry patches around the eyes, though one reviewer with dry skin found it drying rather than moisturizing.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer with sensitive skin developed allergy-like symptoms (itchy, watery eyes, sneezing) despite no burning, while another with sensitive and dry under-eyes reported no irritation, only hydration.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 30s to 70s describe the cream as effective for hooded lids, sagging, crepey eyelid skin and fine lines, with several long-time users reporting continued improvement over weeks to months, though a few mature-skin reviewers saw no change after two to three weeks.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers report visible reduction in fine lines, crepey eyelid skin, sagging, and hooded lids, often within one to several uses, though a handful using it for one to three weeks report no noticeable change in wrinkles or eyebags.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers frequently describe the cream as hydrating and plumping, with some noting relief from dry, tired-looking or dry-patched under-eyes; one reviewer with dry skin, however, found it drying rather than moisturizing.
concerns.redness: No reviewer specifically reports redness as a concern or outcome.
concerns.barrier: No reviewer specifically discusses barrier repair or damage.
concerns.spots: No reviewer discusses spots or discoloration beyond dark circles, which fall under aging/dehydration mentions here.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports the cream broke her out in several places, while another prone to milia notes this product does not cause milia unlike thicker creams; opinions diverge.
concerns.oiliness: No reviewer reports oiliness as a concern with this product.

aspects.libelle: Thick texture feels heavy if overused
Wears well under makeup, no pilling

extraits.texte: I love the phyto nature oxygen cream so when this eye cream was launched, I had to try it. I found the eye cream to be drying and not moisterizing. I use Dermalogica products almost exclusively but this one isn't on par with their quality. You would be better off using the phyto moisturizer under your eyes. This will be returned.

Unfortunately, this eye cream broke me out in several places. I didn't notice any lifting of the eyes from using this either as it claims. It's a very thick eye cream and does feel nice in the skin. The packaging is lovely as well. This was gifted by Dermalogica.

This product actually works really well. I was starting to see serious improvement in my hooded lids within a little over a week. However, I began developing massive allergy symptoms. I'm not allowing it to affect my rating though, because that's a "me" issue, not their fault. I have super sensitive skin, and it didn't burn or anything, I just started noticing itchy, watery eyes and sneezing (not sick). After I washed it off this morning, I felt almost immediate relief. Really sad about it, because it took me weeks to convince myself to spend the money.

Gifted by dermalogica- This eye cream is just as amazing as its serum and moisturizer counterparts. I have sensitive and dry under eyes and have not experienced any irritation only all night hydration, my inner corner wrinkles have smoothed out and my eyes are noticeably brighter! I highly recommend this and the rest of Phyto line especially if you have mature skin and want to eliminate using too many products.

I am thrilled with the Phyto Nature Lifting Eye Cream! As someone in their 40s with dry skin and fine lines around the eyes, I've struggled to find a moisturizer that truly delivers. But this eye cream has exceeded my expectations. The texture is silky and smooth, absorbing effortlessly into my skin. Not only does it keep my face hydrated throughout the day, but it also provides a lifted look and visibly reduces signs of aging over time. Makeup glides on seamlessly over the cream, and it's not greasy at all—just super hydrating. The secret lies in its powerful ingredients: Quinoa Seed Extract: Visibly reduces eyelid folds and refines skin texture. Adaptogenic Astragalus, Electric Daisy Flower, and CoQ10: Smooth and visibly tighten for that lifted appearance. Powerful Peptides: Firm the skin, enhance resilience, and defend against free radicals. In an independent clinical test, 97% of participants showed lifting in their upper eyelids, a more even skin tone, and brighter skin after using this cream twice a day for 8 weeks1. I'm hooked! If you're looking for an effective eye cream that truly delivers, give the Phyto Nature Lifting Eye Cream a try. Your eyes will thank you! ✨ Gifted by Dermalogica

This eye cream is incredible. It's so thick and moisturizing and exactly what my dry under eyes desperately needed. Two weeks use has greatly improved my under eyes. I really think the peptides in the formula are making a huge difference and exactly what my skincare routine has been missing!! The bottle is aesthetically pleasing and looks great on my counter. The pump works without issue and dispenses the proper amount. Overall this is a wonderful eye cream and I look forward to using it daily! Gifted by dermalogica

I love this eye cream. It makes my eye area feel and look a lot more smooth. My concealer goes on a lot smoother and it reduces the amount of creasing I get. I'm also prone to milia under the ye if an eye cream is too thick and this one doesn't do that. Recieved complimentary from Dermalogica for review.
